data_type: label-conditioned artificial separability; not clinical evidence
selection: minimum inner-validation cross entropy; outer validation used once after selection
missing_class: strict 3class macro undefined; separate present-class BA
split: outer StratifiedKFold over 81 files; outer-development files split 80/20 stratified for inner validation; repeated files from one simulated instance may cross folds

generation_protocol.scale: median within-file population SD across these 81 unenhanced sources; simulation design, not model training scaler
generation_protocol.limitation: Uses class labels to construct artificial separability. Not proof of clinical separability, efficacy or statistical significance. Not necessarily physically plausible. Synthetic instance IDs are not independent patient IDs.

architecture_note: Revision3: two-layer unidirectional LSTM64/GRU64; both module-removal variants are identical plain UniLSTM, not single-factor ablations. Compact Transformer uses local128 windows. CNN and MSCNN recurrent layers were already unidirectional. See architecture.txt.
